fix(autocmd) : generate `Dirchanged` event manually / Repeated lcd modifications

1) Problem

There is no root cache checking. Every opening file, `BufRead`,
`BufWinEnter`, `LspAttach` occur together, It causes the 'lcd' command
to execute repeatedly when a buffer is opened.

vim.cmd() prevent to generate 'Dirchanged' event, so We need to make it
manually. Then, this event occurs 4 times at every visiting buffer.

2) Solution

Use cache variable `prev_root`, If pwd is different with it, lcd
executes.
`Dirchanged` event occurs also. So We can use this event normally.

1) Problem

Default python indentexpr from ftplugin has some bugs.
It set vim.bo.shiftwidth*2 as default tab.
It cannot detect comment/todo/string region properly, it makes too many
indent is applied when user input <CR> at comment region which is in parentheses.
It is annoying.

2) Solution

use treesitter to capture comment region. fix this bugs.
Default indentexpr uses .vim script, but it is reconstruct using lua.

set vim.bo.shiftwidth as default.
You don't need to disable parenthese_indenting

fix(blink) : change kind_name of completion menu for texlab

texlab supports completion. but tex use different categories unlike other languages.
But the lsp's CompletionItemKind property is used public purposes.

To show proper kind of the completion item, blink.cmp use three cases.
First, check item.kind_name
If not, Seconds, use their own CompletionItemKind. It makes that
changing vim.lsp.protocol in textDocument/completion handler doesn't
work in blink.cmp completion because it use own itemkind.
If not, Third, use 'Unknown'

So I have to change blink.cmp setting to change this.
